newsitem.title: FRANCE: GTM falls heavily on results, outlook.
newsitem.headline: GTM falls heavily on results, outlook.

text.p: Shares in French construction company GTM Entrepose fell sharply on Tuesday after the group posted a deeper loss for the first half and forecast lower profits for the full year.
An analyst at a leading French brokerage said she expected GTM to post at best breakeven or a small loss for the full year 1996 result.

Shares in GTM, which is 48-percent owned by Lyonnaise des Eaux, fell 8.03 percent to 252 francs at 1045 GMT. It posted a first-half net attributable loss of 23 million francs versus a loss of 18 million a year ago.

GTM said in a statement it expected a decline in full year 1996 results if activity in the road building sector did not pick up by the end of the year and if the building sector and the 1997 outlook forced it to take further restructuring measures.
Turnover for the year would be similar to 1995, it said.
